turns.question: which relay alarms the onyx when the 230V is off?
turns.answer:

- **The SMS module documentation** — given the Lanzarote note references an "SMS 230V alarm," the SMS module is likely the interface; its wiring into ONYX would be in that sub-schematic

Do you have the ONYX wiring drawings in the folder? If you can pull up the alarm input sheet, I can help you trace it from there.
